HAL Apprentice Recruitment 2026: Graduate and Diploma Holders Can Apply Online

31 Oct 2026, 03:16 AM IST · GlobeWire Daily Careers Desk · Source: navbharattimes.indiatimes.com

Key takeawaysHindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL) has released an official recruitment notification for apprentice positions, inviting applications from eligible engineering graduates, non-engineering graduates, and diploma holders. The application process is being conducted online.

Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL) has released an official recruitment notification for apprentice positions, inviting applications from eligible engineering graduates, non-engineering graduates, and diploma holders. The application process is being conducted online.

Overview of Available Positions

The engagement covers several categories of apprenticeships tailored to specific educational qualifications:

  • Engineering Graduate Apprentice: Candidates must hold a 4-year BE/BTech degree from a recognized university in relevant branches such as Electronics, Mechanical, Electrical, Civil, or Computer Science/Information Technology.
  • Non-Engineering Graduate Apprentice: Requires a 3-year degree in disciplines like BCA, BSc Computer Science, BCom, or BA, while BSc Agriculture applicants must possess a 4-year degree.
  • Technician (Diploma Technical) Apprentice: Applicants need a 3-year diploma in engineering fields including Electronics, Mechanical, Electrical, Civil, or Computer Science/IT.
  • Technician (Non-Technical Diploma) Apprentice: Requires a 3-year diploma in General Nursing and Midwifery (GNM) or a 2-year diploma in MOM and SP.

Age Limits and Relaxations

Upper age limits apply based on the candidate's category. The general age limit is set at 26 years, with permissible upper age relaxations extending up to 29 years for OBC candidates and 31 years for SC/ST candidates. Additional age relaxations are applicable for PwBD candidates in accordance with established guidelines.

Application Procedure

Interested applicants must complete a registration process through the NATS portal to generate a registration number before applying. Following registration, candidates must access the official HAL website or the designated notification link to locate the online Google Form. Applicants are required to provide their personal and educational details, enter their NATS registration number, upload necessary documents, and submit the form online.

Practical Implications and Verification

  • What is Confirmed: The notification outlines specific educational branches, degree requirements, upper age criteria with category-based relaxations, and a two-step application process involving the NATS portal and an online form.
  • What is Unknown: Specific details regarding exact seat counts per trade, exact final merit list preparation dates, and complete day-to-day counseling schedules are managed through the official portal notifications.
  • How Readers Can Verify: Candidates should carefully read the official notification document and access the registration links directly via the official source link provided below.
